cobblemon.species.nebix.name: Nebix
cobblemon.species.nebix.desc1: Nebix appears during meteor showers, dancing under the falling stars. Its flowing tail collects cosmic energy, which gives it a gentle purple glow. In Northala folklore, seeing a Nebix is said to bring good luck for one full moon cycle.
cobblemon.species.voryn.name: Voryn
cobblemon.species.voryn.desc1: Voryn's tail and crest shimmer with cosmic energy, creating a gradient of purple and gold that resembles the twilight sky. Ancient stone carvings throughout the Northala region depict Voryn as a messenger between worlds. It is often spotted near mountain peaks during auroras, where it absorbs celestial energy through the star-like patterns in its fur.
cobblemon.species.cosvul.name: Cosvul
cobblemon.species.cosvul.desc1: Cosvul's body contains fragments of cosmic energy from the birth of stars. Its ethereal mane and tail shimmer with galaxies and starlight, changing colors with the phases of the moon. Ancient texts in the Northala region depict it as a guardian that maintains balance between dreams and reality. When the aurora appears in the sky, Cosvul howls, creating harmonious melodies that resonate through the mountains.
cobblemon.species.mythirin.name: Mythirin
cobblemon.species.mythirin.desc1: Mythirin watches over all waters of Northala, from mountain springs to coastal fjords. Ancient carvings show it bringing rainfall after devastating droughts. Its azure body flows between liquid and solid forms as it travels through rivers, lakes, and waterfalls. When Northala's waters are threatened, Mythirin's antlers glow with a brilliant blue light that can be seen from distant peaks.
cobblemon.species.bamzu.name: Bamzu
cobblemon.species.bamzu.desc1: Bamzu grows a small bamboo shoot atop its head that acts as a periscope in tall grass. The spiral pattern on its body stores energy absorbed from sunlight. Young Bamzu gather in groves where they practice defensive stances.
cobblemon.species.bambud.name: Bambud
cobblemon.species.bambud.desc1: Bambud's arms have developed into hollow tubes that it uses to launch seeds with surprising accuracy. The bronze bands around its body are naturally formed from minerals absorbed through its roots. It's known to stand guard at the entrances to bamboo forests.
cobblemon.species.bamnon.name: Bamnon
cobblemon.species.bamnon.desc1: Bamnon's powerful cannons can launch bamboo spears that can pierce stone. Its body is protected by armor made of hardened bamboo and natural bronze. Ancient warriors of Northala would form special bonds with Bamnon, working together to protect mountain villages from threats.
cobblemon.species.flarin.name: Flarin
cobblemon.species.flarin.desc1: Flarin can be found dancing among wildflowers in Northala's secret groves, where their flame-tipped antlers cast a warm glow on dewy petals. During full moons, groups of Flarin gather to perform mysterious rituals that cause the surrounding flowers to bloom with vibrant colors regardless of season.
cobblemon.species.pyrilis.name: Pyrilis
cobblemon.species.pyrilis.desc1: Pyrilis inhabits Northala's flowering valleys, cultivating magical gardens with its enchanted flames. The gem on its forehead absorbs sunlight, allowing it to maintain these sacred groves even through harsh winters.
cobblemon.species.solafae.name: Solafae
cobblemon.species.solafae.desc1: Solafae guards Northala's ancient flower sanctuaries. Its sacred dance causes Nordic frost flowers and tropical orchids to bloom together in harmony. Historical records show a Solafae creating the first grove where ancestors established the peaceful cultural fusion that defines Northala today.
cobblemon.species.yaknoi.name: Yaknoi
cobblemon.species.yaknoi.desc1: Yaknoi train diligently near Northala's sacred waterfalls. They are born with golden ornaments that grows more elaborate as they train. Villages often adopt these Pokemon to protect local shrines, offering red prayer beads as a sign of partnership.
cobblemon.species.yakru.name: Yakru
cobblemon.species.yakru.desc1: Yakru's training intensifies with age, causing its decorative elements to grow more ornate. Its eyebrows lengthen when it concentrates its fighting energy. In ancient times, pairs of Yakru would stand guard at the entrance to Northala's most sacred temples.
cobblemon.species.yakhan.name: Yakhan
cobblemon.species.yakhan.desc1: Legends say that when Northala faced its greatest flood, a powerful Yakhan summoned divine strength to hold back the waters. Throughout history, these Pokemon have protected sacred sites from threats both natural and human. When a Yakhan takes a defensive stance, it's said that not even the strongest attacks can breach its territory.
cobblemon.species.oitatum.name: Oitatum
cobblemon.species.oitatum.desc1: Oitatum exists in perfect balance between flame and shadow. Legends say it appears to those caught between two paths. When threatened, it can shift its energy to favor either fire or darkness, dramatically enhancing its corresponding powers.
cobblemon.species.oitatumfire.name: Oitatum Fire
cobblemon.species.oitatumfire.desc1: In its Fire Form, Oitatum's flame energy intensifies to its maximum potential. Its body radiates with heat that can ignite the air around it. Despite its increased power, it can revert to its balanced form when the situation demands it.
cobblemon.species.oitatumdark.name: Oitatum Dark
cobblemon.species.oitatumdark.desc1: When Oitatum shifts to its Dark Form, shadows consume its body and intensify its sinister nature. Its flames turn a deep purple-black and can snuff out light rather than produce it. It retains the ability to return to its balanced form when needed.
cobblemon.species.frostusk.name: Frostusk
cobblemon.species.frostusk.desc1: Frostusk roams the northern plains of Northala, its thick fur insulating it against bitter cold. Its striped horns can detect changes in temperature, helping it find edible plants beneath the snow. Herds gather at natural hot springs during the harshest winters.
cobblemon.species.permafang.name: Permafang
cobblemon.species.permafang.desc1: Permafang's massive horns can shatter glaciers with a single strike. The ice crystals in its fur maintain freezing temperatures even in warmer climates. When threatened, it can create localized blizzards by shaking its thick mane.
cobblemon.species.owlyn.name: Owlyn
cobblemon.species.owlyn.desc1: Owlyn are born when moonlight reflects on morning dew in Northala's ancient forests. Their wide eyes can see clearly in both day and night. The golden crest on their head is said to glow faintly to guide lost travelers home.
cobblemon.species.striglow.name: Striglow
cobblemon.species.striglow.desc1: Striglow watches over Northala from high peaks, its keen eyes detecting danger miles away. Its glowing crest serves as a beacon through storms and darkness, guiding lost travelers to safety. Local villages carve Celestria symbols above doorways, believing they ward off misfortune and provide protection.
cobblemon.species.valkestra.name: Valkestra
cobblemon.species.valkestra.desc1: Valkestra soars above Northala's skies, choosing worthy trainers and Pokemon for its protection. Ancient texts describe how it bridged the divide between warring northern frost tribes and southern island clans by carrying leaders to a sacred summit where peace was negotiated. It appears only to those who show exceptional courage and honor.
